description: The runner: schedules and runs the tasks of published packages, each in a process of its own, with retries, time and memory limits, run history and progress, over a management API a console pairs with. Needs the .NET 10 runtime (ASP.NET Core).
notes: The state, certificate, package cache and scratch space live in the server's data directory, away from the program files; the task host is installed in the taskhost folder beside the program. The state database is a SQLite file in that directory (one runner); for a group of runners sharing one database run: dbdatarunner state init. Start it with: dbdatarunner server run. Pair a console with it: dbdatarunner server pair --max-role admin. Put a package in for development with: dbdatarunner package install <manifest.yaml> <directory>.
